Implement pathway with order sets, education, and real-time adherence monitoring
Evaluate outcomes using statistical process control and publish results
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — hospital standardized mortality ratio using clinical registry and coding data. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — hospital standardized mortality ratio measured monthly. Target: HSMR below 100. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against Dr. Foster/CIHI benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — hospital standardized mortality ratio trending toward HSMR below 90. Escalate if <HSMR below 110 ceiling. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using CIHI HSMR methodology. Report to Chief Medical Officer.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a neuroscience clinical program director for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
